'''Kaltemmic''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] clan that was led and represented on the [[Three Families]] by [[Portho Kaltemmic]] on [[Quesh]].

==Behind the scenes==
The existence of the Kaltemmic clan is implied by the [[Portho Kaltemmic|Portho's]] [[Cuirvas|cuivras]], of which identifies a Hutt's clan.
